entries.09dc0fc249c8295a: It is a business that operates the performance-based advertising service "PRESCO." Advertisements are placed on websites of advertising media, and the company receives a performance fee when the advertiser approves a viewer's application or purchase. In addition, using RPA and other technologies, it collects, aggregates and reports marketing data such as search keywords and search ranking data for the online advertising industry, including advertising agencies and online media operators. Open Co., Ltd. is responsible for this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥1,317 million.
